what: A six-track electro groovebox with a sample-fed vocoder and five synth patches shaped by sounds from our Roland SH-01A. The Hub install is firmware-only; the optional Miami vocal pack comes through the BGIRL web installer.
author: Doug Smith (dougbtv)
sounds: own: BGIRL Miami and legacy G6 vocals (maker declaration); also includes CC0 Hügelton and Versilian sounds and BGIRL synthetic speech.
